friendly_name: Bitz the Cyber Cat macOS Desktop Companion
purpose_context: Implement Bitz the Cyber Cat in Swift 6, SwiftUI, AppKit, and RiveRuntime inside a borderless floating NSPanel overlay (<2% CPU, <70MB RAM) with WellnessPointEngine and ActivityMonitorService.
purpose_tldr: Native macOS 14+ transparent click-through Rive desktop mascot driven by wellness and PC thermal state.
